span.p: von Uexkuell — Foray + Theory of Meaning

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
[INTERP-high]
closed meaning-world =
Dasein's world; Heidegger
cites Uexkuell directly
(U-F0, U-F7, U-M1)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
[INTERP-high]
carrier of meaning =
ready-to-hand entity
within referential totality
(U-M1)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
[INTERP-high]
relationless object =
presence-at-hand
(U-M1)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
[INTERP-high]
mood as prior condition
for how entities show up;
not secondary coloring
(U-F4, U-F6)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
[INTERP-high]
effect tone (sitting,
climbing) = biosemiotic
analogue of as-structure
and in-order-to
(U-F4, U-M1, U-M4)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[INTERP-high]
meaning-tone = Bewandtnis
(involvement); Planmässigkeit
= totality of involvements
(U-F3, U-M1)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
[INTERP-high]
self-enclosed dwelling =
existential spatiality;
always already inhabiting
(U-M1)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
[INTERP-high]
world-score as total
meaning-composition =
worldhood of the world
(U-M5, U-M6)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
[INTERP-high]
inscrutable formative
melody: what gives beings
their being cannot be
grasped = ontological
difference (U-M6)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
[INTERP-high]
passive meaning-reception
against interest = Dasein's
thrownness into unchosen
situation (U-M5)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[INTERP-high]
primal image as non-physical
form guiding morphogenesis
= Aristotelian eidos as
formal cause (U-M3)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
[INTERP-high]
graduated Umwelt simplicity
(paramecium to tick) =
biological material for
world-poverty thesis
(U-F2, U-F4)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
[INTERP-high]
search image as free
production of the subject
= priority of projection
over perception (U-F6)
